popup.heading: Commanding the Vanguard
popup.body: Left-click your Hero (or tap on mobile) to select them. Drag a box around multiple units to command your whole squad.

popup.heading: Movement Orders
popup.body: Right-click on the gravel road ahead (or long-press on touchscreens) to march your selected squad toward the Sunken Ford.

popup.heading: Control Groups (1-4)
popup.body: Press Ctrl+1 while your squad is selected to bind Group 1. Press 1 anytime to snap back to them, or double-tap 1 to center the camera.

popup.heading: Attack-Move & Formations
popup.body: Press A and click ahead to Attack-Move. Keep your pikemen in front of your archers so leaping Briar Hounds cannot flank your backline.

popup.heading: Spells & Autocast
popup.body: Click a spell icon on the bottom bar (or right-click it to toggle Autocast). Briar Hounds and Ghouls take bonus damage from fire.

popup.heading: Pause & Queue Orders
popup.body: Press Space (or tap the Pause icon) to freeze the battlefield while issuing moves, heals, and target priorities.

popup.heading: Gold & Equipment
popup.body: Walk over dropped gold piles and gear sacks to collect them. Open your Inventory (I) to equip upgrades or check item stats.

popup.heading: Potions & Shrines
popup.body: Use a healing potion from the belt when your hero drops below half HP, or activate roadside shrines to restore stamina and receive blessings.

popup.heading: Smithy, Tavern & Contracts
popup.body: After clearing the ford, visit Thornwick to sell surplus loot to Master Kaelen, hire mercenaries in the tavern, and pick up side-quest contracts.

popup.heading: Ready for the Frontier
popup.body: Your campaign autosaves locally. Use Export Save in the menu to back up your progress, or download Chapter Packs for offline play.
